description: This source file contains unit tests for the NodeAppModel class and associated components in the OpenClaw project. It includes test cases for deep link handling, message encoding, session key logic, notification authorization, watch messaging, and command handling, among others.

classes.name: MockWatchMessagingService
classes.description: A mock implementation of WatchMessagingServicing for testing watch notification interactions.

classes.name: MockBootstrapNotificationCenter
classes.description: A mock notification center implementation for testing notification authorization flow.

classes.name: NodeAppModelInvokeTests
classes.description: A struct containing multiple unit tests for NodeAppModel's core functionalities, including deep link handling, command execution, and watch notifications.

methods.name: decodeParamsFailsWithoutJSON
methods.description: Tests that decoding parameters fails when no JSON is provided.

methods.name: encodePayloadEmitsJSON
methods.description: Tests that encoding a payload emits valid JSON containing expected fields.

methods.name: chatSessionKeyDefaultsToMainBase
methods.description: Ensures that the default chat session key is 'main'.

methods.name: chatSessionKeyUsesAgentScopedKeyForNonDefaultAgent
methods.description: Verifies that the session key uses a specific agent ID when a non-default agent is selected.

methods.name: operatorLoopWaitsForBootstrapHandoffBeforeUsingStoredToken
methods.description: Tests the logic determining whether the operator loop should start based on bootstrap tokens and stored operator tokens.

methods.name: successfulBootstrapOnboardingRequestsNotificationAuthorization
methods.description: Ensures that notification authorization is requested upon successful bootstrap onboarding.

methods.name: clearingBootstrapTokenStripsReconnectConfigEvenWithoutPersistence
methods.description: Verifies that clearing the bootstrap token removes relevant reconnect configuration while retaining other data.

methods.name: handleInvokeRejectsBackgroundCommands
methods.description: Checks that invoke commands for background actions are rejected appropriately.

methods.name: handleInvokeRejectsCameraWhenDisabled
methods.description: Confirms that camera commands are rejected when camera is disabled in user defaults.

methods.name: handleInvokeRejectsInvalidScreenFormat
methods.description: Tests that invalid screen record formats are correctly rejected.

methods.name: handleInvokeCanvasCommandsUpdateScreen
methods.description: Validates that canvas commands update the screen URL and evaluate JavaScript correctly.

methods.name: pendingForegroundActionsReplayCanvasNavigate
methods.description: Checks that pending foreground actions are replayed correctly, updating the screen URL.

methods.name: pendingForegroundActionsDoNotApplyWhileBackgrounded
methods.description: Verifies that foreground actions are not applied when the app is backgrounded.

methods.name: handleInvokeA2UICommandsFailWhenHostMissing
methods.description: Tests that certain A2UI commands fail when host configuration is missing.

methods.name: handleInvokeUnknownCommandReturnsInvalidRequest
methods.description: Ensures that unknown commands return an invalid request error.

methods.name: handleInvokeWatchStatusReturnsServiceSnapshot
methods.description: Checks that the watch status command returns a proper service snapshot.

methods.name: handleInvokeWatchNotifyRoutesToWatchService
methods.description: Verifies that watch notification commands are routed to the watch messaging service and payloads are correct.

methods.name: handleInvokeWatchNotifyRejectsEmptyMessage
methods.description: Ensures empty messages are rejected for watch notifications.

methods.name: handleInvokeWatchNotifyAddsDefaultActionsForPrompt
methods.description: Verifies default actions are added when sending a watch notification with a prompt.

methods.name: handleInvokeWatchNotifyAddsApprovalDefaults
methods.description: Checks that approval prompts have correct default actions.

methods.name: handleInvokeWatchNotifyDerivesPriorityFromRiskAndCapsActions
methods.description: Ensures that notification priority is derived correctly based on risk and actions.

methods.name: handleInvokeWatchNotifyReturnsUnavailableOnDeliveryFailure
methods.description: Tests that delivery failures result in an 'unavailable' error.

methods.name: watchReplyQueuesWhenGatewayOffline
methods.description: Verifies that watch replies are queued when the gateway is offline.

methods.name: handleDeepLinkSetsErrorWhenNotConnected
methods.description: Ensures that deep links error appropriately when not connected.

methods.name: handleDeepLinkRejectsOversizedMessage
methods.description: Checks that oversized messages are rejected in deep link handling.

methods.name: handleDeepLinkRequiresConfirmationWhenConnectedAndUnkeyed
methods.description: Verifies confirmation prompt is shown for unkeyed deep link requests when connected.

methods.name: handleDeepLinkCoalescesPromptWhenRateLimited
methods.description: Ensures multiple deep link prompts are coalesced when rate-limited.

methods.name: handleDeepLinkStripsDeliveryFieldsWhenUnkeyed
methods.description: Tests that delivery fields are stripped from deep link prompts when unkeyed.

methods.name: handleDeepLinkRejectsLongUnkeyedMessageWhenConnected
methods.description: Verifies long unkeyed messages are rejected.

methods.name: handleDeepLinkBypassesPromptWithValidKey
methods.description: Ensures that deep links with valid keys bypass prompts.

methods.name: sendVoiceTranscriptThrowsWhenGatewayOffline
methods.description: Tests that sending voice transcripts fails when offline.

methods.name: canvasA2UIActionDispatchesStatus
methods.description: Checks that A2UI actions dispatch status updates correctly.
